summary: End-to-end testing of NEXORIA Nexus Online V2 (isometric MMORPG hub + Game Master Panel). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed covering Socket.IO handshake, chat, move, all 9 GM events with role enforcement, MongoDB gm_audit_log persistence, /api/admin/gm-audit, /api/nexus/rooms, pickup_item. Frontend: Nexus page loads isometric Phaser canvas, all 3 room tabs work, GM panel opens for admin only, all action buttons (mute/freeze/kick/ban/teleport/weather/announce/spawn/invisible) are wired with correct data-testids, ban modal works, weather change updates status bar (PLUIE → ORAGE → CIEL CLAIR). Non-staff role correctly denied on server side.
critical_code_review_comments: nexus_world.py is 619 lines — close to the 700-line threshold; future GM commands may push it over. Consider splitting GM handlers into a separate module.
frontend/src/pages/Nexus.js is 1227 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting NexusIsoScene (Phaser scene) into a separate file and the GMPanel overlay into its own component.

Sprite/tile texture generation in Phaser scene runs Canvas2D getImageData (browser warning: 'willReadFrequently' attribute missing). Add `willReadFrequently: true` when creating canvas to fix perf warning.

gm-panel modal overlay (data-testid=gm-panel applied to outer 'fixed inset-0' div) makes it appear opened/clickable in tests even when overlay covers everything. Consider moving data-testid=gm-panel onto the inner content div for cleaner test semantics.

When admin opens GM panel from the top-right button, the player list in the right sidebar is occluded by the modal overlay — admin must close panel and click a player row (which re-opens panel). UX: consider adding a player picker INSIDE the GM panel itself.

Test data leak: registered TEST_user_* accounts and TEST_BAN ban rows are not cleaned up automatically. Recommend a /api/admin/test-cleanup endpoint or post-test teardown that purges users with email prefix 'TEST_'.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_v2.py (NEW — 19 pytest tests for full Nexus V2 surface)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids resolved; admin can open GM panel, select target, see all action buttons, change weather, open ban modal; non-staff role properly denied server-side)

test_credentials: admin@nexoria.com / NexoriaAdmin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Regular users registered on the fly via POST /api/auth/register with email @example.com (the .test TLD is rejected by email validator).
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates 1 fresh TEST_user_*@example.com account; ~12 leftover test users + ~10 gm_audit_log rows + a few ban_history rows. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use python-socketio AsyncClient with socketio_path='/api/nexus/socket.io', auth={'token': <session_token>} (token extracted from session_token cookie after /api/auth/login). Email TLD '.test' is rejected by FastAPI EmailStr validator — use @example.com for TEST_ users. To verify isStaff in frontend correctly: clear BOTH cookies AND localStorage('nx_token') between admin/user role swaps, otherwise localStorage cached token wins over fresh cookie. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_v2.py serve as the regression suite.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. During frontend testing the gm-open-button briefly appeared for a 'regular user' navigation, but this was a test methodology artifact: lib/api.js stores token in localStorage, so swapping only the cookie left the admin token in localStorage, making socket.io reconnect as admin. Server-side socket.IO tests already proved that a fresh regular user receives is_staff:false and all GM events are rejected with system_msg error.
